hash_scope: Recomputed SHA-256 of aggregate tables, small metadata and original receipts read by this audit. Inherited native-data/source hashes are identified separately and were not recomputed; no new native-array/model audit.

frozen_receipt_contents.authorization: Kevin accepted the bounded mapped-water comparison and said keep going; this does not authorize genus-wide pool mapping or mechanistic paleohydrology.
frozen_receipt_contents.point_support: Source S36 section 2.3 explicitly calculates distances at presence and background points; the erroneous trap-array wording remains in the original metadata.
frozen_receipt_contents.water_transform: log1p(distance in kilometres), fixed before fitting
frozen_receipt_contents.background: All public source quadrature points with complete native climate; equal 1 km grid area. No species labels interpreted as absences.
frozen_receipt_contents.primary: Five source spatial-block holdouts of 1995–2016 records; equal-block mean of relative recorded-density scores.
frozen_receipt_contents.secondary: 2017–2020 records with a 5 km training exclusion around every held point; full common public background for evaluation.

quadratic_ridge.form: Additive standardized climate linear/quadratic terms plus linear standardized log-water distances; no interactions; training-background-only scaling; unpenalized intercept.

frozen_receipt_contents.objective: Both families fit weighted native binary cross-entropy to artificial source labels, with equal positive/background mass. Evaluate normalized raw margins as relative recorded density; no occupancy calibration.
frozen_receipt_contents.settings_selection: Fixed controls; no inner or outer tuning, no early stopping and no chosen winner/full map.
known_limits: Three early records in source block 3 and one late record there: no precise regional-effect claim.
Road/urban observation proxies and survey histories are not included; water can partly predict where observers search.
The post-2016 records were already used elsewhere in this project; this is a new exploratory comparison, not fresh external validation.
Static mapped water and 1981–2010 climate normals are paired with dated records; pool persistence and exact water-map dates are unknown.
The study is southern California, with no Baja extension, historical projection or mechanism identification.
